qc._primer_note: empty by design — panel plan window is 260-450 bp; confirm exact primer set (e.g. the lab's LCO/HCO or mICOI variant) at intake SP2

readbased_minimap2.ref_db: biodb-fetch:midori2 --i-accept-license (MIDORI2 LONG/LINC reference, CC-BY-NC — the script refuses without explicit license acceptance) or biodb-fetch:bold --taxon <T> (BOLD REST API, per-taxon COI pulls); MMI + tax_lookup built locally per reference-db/run

readbased_idtaxa.ref_db: NO stock IdTaxa model exists for COI — opt-in only, after training a custom model from the fetched MIDORI2/BOLD FASTA; chain to nf-edna/idtaxa-training. Default classifier is readbased_minimap2.

consensus.classifier_note: COI consensus classifies via minimap2-LCA against MIDORI2/BOLD; no SILVA-model shortcut
